verdict.rationale: Inngest explicitly supports webhook consumption as a first-class trigger mechanism — docs describe creating unique webhook URLs per third-party service to trigger functions, which aligns directly with an AI-native user's need to subscribe to events via webhooks for agentic workflows. This integrates with Inngest's broader event-driven, durable execution model (steps, retries, waitForEvent) making webhook-triggered agent workflows practical. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation specifically of webhook subscription usage (community evidence covers general queueing/scheduling use, not webhooks specifically), and no example of AI-agent-specific webhook subscription pattern.
